_notes: The Farmer Registry's data scopes: what a consent or a Consent Manager policy can name (farmer-registry.<name>).

Scope names are permanent: never rename or reuse one. Change a scope's fields freely (a new version is published; consents given earlier keep what they were given). To split or merge, add new names and drop the old (it is retired).

No default one-per-section scopes (exclude_section_scopes: true): section mnemonics are UI names, and the Household register repeats the Farmer register's sections. Each scope below names its section with section:<mnemonic>, so a section's fields stay in step and a renamed section refuses the catalogue instead of silently retiring a scope.

Not shared at all: the record header (status, approvers, image), documents, ID authentication, the farmer-household link (internal IDs), the intake-only farm input and livestock sections, and the Household register's copies of the Farmer sections.

scopes.name: farmer_identifiers
scopes.label: Farmer ID and national ID
scopes.description: The farmer's registry ID (Farmer ID) and national ID (Fayda), and when the record was registered and last approved. Needed to look the farmer up in other registries (e.g. the Crop Sown Registry knows a farmer by Farmer ID).

scopes.name: personal_details
scopes.label: Personal details
scopes.description: Name, sex, date of birth or estimated age, marital status, education level and language spoken.

scopes.name: contact
scopes.label: Contact details
scopes.description: The farmer's phone numbers, whether they have a personal phone, and email addresses.

scopes.name: location
scopes.label: Farmer's address and location
scopes.description: Where the farmer lives: administrative area, address and GPS point.

scopes.name: main_crops
scopes.label: Main crops
scopes.description: The crops the farmer declared they mainly grow (crop codes).

scopes.name: socio_economic_and_health
scopes.label: Socio-economic and health details
scopes.description: Sources of income, main crops and disability (type and severity). Sensitive: includes health information.

scopes.name: land
scopes.label: Land parcels
scopes.description: Each land parcel's ID, size and unit, tenure, how and when it was acquired, use, farming type and soil fertility — without its location.

scopes.name: land_location
scopes.label: Land parcel locations
scopes.description: Where each land parcel is: administrative area, address, GPS point and boundary.

scopes.name: livestock
scopes.label: Livestock
scopes.description: The farmer's livestock: type, breed, head count and livestock system.

scopes.name: farm_inputs
scopes.label: Farm inputs
scopes.description: Use of improved seed, fertilizer, pesticide and insecticide, water source, and access to finance and machinery.

scopes.name: memberships
scopes.label: Cooperative and cluster memberships
scopes.description: Membership of primary cooperatives, cooperative unions and farmer clusters, with the farmer's role.

scopes.name: household
scopes.label: Household details
scopes.description: The farmer's household: household ID, head, size and composition (children, elderly, female and male members) and other land owners.

scopes.name: household_location
scopes.label: Household address and location
scopes.description: Where the household lives: administrative area, address and GPS point.

scopes.name: household_members
scopes.label: Household members
scopes.description: Each household member's name, sex, date of birth and relationship to the head.

scopes.name: poverty_score
scopes.label: Household poverty score
scopes.description: The household's computed scores (e.g. poverty / PMT score) and when they were computed.
